flags.debarment_reason: You are M/S. Century Traders, Prop. Md. Salim Ullah, Daganbhuiyan, Feni, has done the work mentioned so far C. (i) Improvement of Jogidia GPS-Siraj Miar bazar road (Paschim Birahimpur GPS-Siraj Miar bari) ( Package No: GNP-3 / NOA / COM / 18-19 / W-057, Tender ID-277232).The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) is investigating allegations use of substandard construction materials in that road development works. The investigation has listed i) use of new rods as well as old rods in the pillars of the guide wall, ii) use of 10 mm rods instead of 12 mm rods and iii) use of substandard brick chips in the road and rectification of such faulty work as directed by the authorities during the search. For that reason the decision has been taken by the Anti-Corruption Commission to black listed (debar) your Company. In view of this, as professional misconduct, corruption and fraud have been proved and requested to give a proper explanation as to why no recommendation will be made to the higher authorities for blacklisting (Debar) as per Rule 126 (4) (c) [বিধি ১২৭(৪)(গ) ]of the Public Procurement Rules 2008 through the e-GP System within 07-03-2021.

flags.procuring_entity: HED, Barishal Division, Barishal
flags.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
flags.debarred_by: Organization Name: Local Government Engineering Department (LGED) ;
flags.debarment_reason: The agreement between Procuring Entity Office of the Executive Engineer LGED Barishal and Your Company M/S Topader Construction was signed on 12.05.19. According to the agreement the work start date was 19.05.19 and completion date 19.09.21. After starting the work you stopped the work more than 28 days which is very disappointing. You have been told to start up the work several times both formally and informally . Still you did not start the work at all. So 28 day final Letter was issued for your failure. But you did not respond to the letter. As a fundamental breach of contract for stopping the work for more than 28 days the PE canceled your work which memo no 46.02.0600.000.14.360.19.3420. After that PE informed PD sir the current situation and asked for administrative approval to cancel the work Memo No 46.02.0600.000.14.360.19.487. PD sir gave administrative approval to cancel the work. He also told to take necessary steps for license debarment .Therefore according to PPR-2008 article 1274 for fundamental breach of contract Your work has been cancelled as per Tender document GCC Clause 36.1bi. Also your license will be debarred for 01 One years as a punishment from attending any tender under LGED. You are requested to give proper explanation against your failure to complete the work and why the authority should not debar your license.

flags.debarment_reason: Under the Rural Road and Culvert Maintenance Program & Package No.e-Tender/LGED/Cox/GOBM/17-18/W-12, Work name: Periodic Maintenance of Pukpukuria GPS - Health Center Road from Ch. 110-1050m Chakaria Road ID : 422164005 {Tender ID: 139006) & Package No.e-Tender/LGED/Cox/GOBM/17-18/W-11, Work name: Periodic Maintenance of Fashiakhali UP - Bhangarmukh Via Olisha Bazar Road from Ch.293-1520m & 2110m-2205 Chakaria Road ID : 422163005 {Tender ID: : 139007) You signed both contract agreements with the PE (Executive Engineer, LGED, Cox's Bazar) on 27/02/2018 and 29/01/2018 respectively. As per contract agreements you were bound to complete the works within 06/05/2018 and 05/04/2018 respectively, but you didn't take any necessary action to complete the work within the specified time as per contract. Two written notices (memo no: 46.02.0022.000.14.014-17-2674, Dated: 05/06/2018 & memo no: 46.02.0022.000.14.015-17-2674 (ka), Dated: 05/06/2018) were sent to you from Executive Engineer, LGED, Cox's Bazar on 05/06/2018 to show justified cause for not cancelling your contracts for stoppage of work for more than 28 days as per GCC Clause no 37 (b)(i). As you failed to send any satisfactory clarification regarding the situation, the contracts were cancelled as per GCC Clause no. 37.1 (a) by PE. This activity can be treated as Fraudulent Practice according to rule 127(2)(Kha) of PPR 2008. So, you are requested to give explanation within 7 (Seven) days why you shall not be debarred from participating in any procurement of Local Government Engineering Department (LGED) for 2 (Two) years, subjected to approval of HOPE, as per PPR 2008, rule 127 (4)(Ga). This is asked according to rule 127(3) of PPR 2008.

So, you are requested to give explanation within 7 (Seven) days why you shall not be debarred from participating in any procurement of Local Government Engineering Department (LGED) for 2 (Two) years, subjected to approval of HOPE, as per PPR 2008, rule 127 (4)(Ga). This is asked according to rule 127(3) of PPR 2008.
